limits: Only the assigned synthetic D2 case, frozen incomplete D2 archive and 28 assigned packets were used. Novelty classifications are local to that archive; no actual-world outcome or global novelty was measured.

Usefulness scores rate explicit links to time, contents or unaided arrangement, not likelihood of success. Every opening specifies a concrete comparison or error outcome; observability 2 does not imply adequate sample size, causal identification or statistical power.

Fit assesses the proposed bounded next probe, not immediate deployment. Sample work with existing parts/board, reversible presentation changes and stated budget/delivery gates generally preserves commitments even where the packet calls adoption uncertain. No opening explicitly relaxes a hard premise or recommends a definite violation.

P023 A2 needs an unspecified force-measurement resource, so its probe fit is uncertain. Distill D4 retains uncertainty and costs/time gates rather than certifying usability; it is not classified as an unresolved fit falsely presented as usable.

Reuse, combined sample allocation and participant exposure require planning. Several raw lanes separately consume most available samples or all ten participants. Distill usually caps, prioritizes or merges them; P010 and P016 still lack a clear shared participant schedule. This is an execution limitation, not evidence that an accepted-order deadline or spending cap was violated.

Retained means the distinctive causal relation remains intelligible, including merged or provisionally parked ideas. It does not endorse action. Prioritization in P006, P022 and P025 leaves other ideas represented. No substantive mechanism family first appears only in Distill; added controls or compressed gate wording do not establish a new family.

Questions and proposed interventions are supported by inference or speculation, not demonstrated effects. Identifiable rhetorical framing is recorded only from packet wording; no condition labels or peer judgments were sought. Small or reused samples, first-use competition and unobserved replacement demand limit stronger conclusions.
